recommendation: Keep the audit commit as-is. Handle future maturity-level changes as separate artifact- or resource-specific issues, not as a reopening of this broad baseline FMM coverage request.
issue_request: FHIR-8308 is a Published/Persuasive FHIR-core DSTU1 change request asking to add FMM gradings and give all resources an FMM level.
initial_application: No explicit git commit mentioning FHIR-8308 was found. The issue predates much of the current source layout; FMM documentation and resource metadata have been retained through later versions-page and StructureDefinition source refactors.
additional_context: source/fhir.ini provides the active resource build-scope list. source/versions.html currently defines FMM 0 through FMM 6 and says all artifacts are assigned a maturity level. A coverage check over active resources found structuredefinition-fmm metadata on every corresponding resource StructureDefinition. FHIR-8308-specific Zulip and Confluence searches did not find conflicting community evidence.
reconciliation: Published an empty no-change audit commit on the combined branch. No source edit is needed because the broad DSTU1 request is already satisfied in current source.
